name: Intra-Company Transfer Visa
description: The D-7 visa is for employees of foreign companies being transferred to their Korean branch, subsidiary, or affiliate. It enables multinational corporations to relocate essential personnel to Korea.
tagline: Transfer to Korea with your company
keyRequirement: 1+ year employment at foreign company with Korean branch
targetAudience: Technical specialists relocating to Korean operations

restrictions: Must work at sponsoring company only
workPermission.notes: Cannot change employers without changing visa status
